name: nas
author: octos
description: Browse, read and search files on a Synology NAS via the FileStation Web API. Requires environment variables NAS_URL (e.g. https://nas.example.com:5001), NAS_USER and NAS_PASS. Accounts with 2-step verification are not supported. Set NAS_VERIFY_TLS=false to accept self-signed HTTPS certificates.

tools.name: nas_list_folder
tools.description: List the contents of a folder on the NAS. With no path (or '/') it lists the available shared folders. Otherwise pass a path that starts with a share, e.g. '/photo' or '/video/2024'.

path.description: Folder path starting with a share name, e.g. '/photo'. Omit or use '/' to list all shared folders.

tools.name: nas_read_file
tools.description: Read a text file from the NAS and return its contents. Refuses files larger than 1 MB or files that are not valid UTF-8 text.

path.description: Full file path starting with a share name, e.g. '/photo/notes.txt'.

tools.name: nas_search
tools.description: Recursively search a NAS folder for files whose name matches a glob pattern. Returns the matching file paths.

folder.description: Folder to search under, starting with a share name, e.g. '/photo'.
